basic_details.job_title: Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nalanda Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nalanda is engaging three support staff for the Evening Court, Nalanda, on a contractual basis: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly. Only retired employees of the Civil Courts may apply. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nalanda on or before 20 December 2026, either personally or through registered post.

content_sections.heading: About Nalanda District Court Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nalanda, Bihar, and is titled "Notice Inviting Applications for Engagement of Support Staff in the Evening Court of Nalanda Judgeship". The engaged staff will work in the Evening Court, Nalanda. Copies of the notice were sent to all Principal District & Sessions Judges of Bihar for display on their notice boards, and to the Judge-in-Charge, Civil Courts, Biharsharif/Hilsa and the System Officer, Biharsharif.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nalanda on or before 20 December 2026. The notice allows two routes: hand the application in personally at the office, or send it through registered post. The notice does not print a fuller postal address, an application form or a format for the application, and it gives no instruction for the envelope.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired court employees who have retired within the last three years, "prior to the period as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna", may apply. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records. The applicant should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification or an age limit for any of the three posts. For the post-wise eligibility, candidates should refer to the official notification. The notice prints no amount. It states that the period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Nalanda District Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts in the Evening Court, Nalanda: one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nalanda on or before 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Nalanda Evening Court support staff posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts may apply, who retired within the last three years as per the guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are physically and mentally fit, and have satisfactory service records without any major disciplinary punishment.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the application to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Nalanda, either personally or through registered post, so that it reaches the office by 20 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What experience is required for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing.

faq.question: Q6. What is required for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: The applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice prints no amount; remuneration shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time as per the directions of the Hon'ble High Court Patna, and gives no right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q9. What are the working hours?
faq.answer: The selected candidates must perform their duties for a minimum of 05 hours on each working day.
